rites.name: Tosterium
rites.text: Tosterium is a veil of hardened tidal salt that the drowned sea-kings of Amontirnium weave into their silver nets, so that anything caught within it slowly loses the will to move. Those who wear its shimmer can calm storms and still the deepest trenches, though the stillness lingers in them long after the sea has gone quiet.

rites.name: Neolor
rites.text: Neolor is the collective name for the first brood of primordial powers, born from the formless void that preceded all things in Amontirnium. Their combined labors gave shape to the heavens, the deep earth, and the currents of desire and night that bind the cosmos together.

rites.name: Syivsith
rites.text: Syivsith is the concept of the Nine Doors of Amontirnium, a force that binds the thresholds where one world meets another during the Courts of the second Era. It is less a single being than a principle of passage that the Courts invoke whenever a door must be weighed, sealed, or opened.

rites.name: Ashisteth
rites.text: Ashisteth is the concept of a sworn bond that held the broken shards of Amontirnium together after the Sundering. It is remembered as the thread the Pact was tied with, a principle rather than a being, and it is invoked whenever the Fall is spoken of.

rites.name: Isaseth
rites.text: Isaseth is the concept of a bound and walled order within Amontirnium, personified in the Walled Age as the force that holds back the flood of unshaped forces. Its orders keep watch over the great walls and the first crossings, where it teaches each generation that a boundary is a promise kept. Its strength lies in patience and in the refusal to let any gate stand open unguarded.

rites.name: Caustanum
rites.text: Caustanum is the quiet measure that keeps Amontirnium's fires from consuming their own hearths, a patient discipline that the realm's oldest kilns were built to honor. Its presence is felt less as a force than as the refusal of excess, where even the mightiest burning is asked to stop at exactly what is needed.

rites.name: Telauntes
rites.text: Telauntes is the quiet discipline of a people who kneel before the unseen, a concept that gives shape to patience, humility, and the careful keeping of vows. In the Mythic age of Amontirnium it is said to steady the hands of those who serve, so that even the mightiest oath is kept without tremor.

rites.name: Ciaronum
rites.text: Ciaronum is the hush that settles over a memory just before it dissolves, a concept given the shape of a grey-veiled woman who walks the edges of every recollection in Amontirnium. Where she passes, names blur and debts are quietly forgiven, and her presence is felt as a soft ache behind the eyes rather than as any sound or light.

rites.name: Mauror
rites.text: Mauror is a mythic concept of pale ceremonial vigil, a single sealed instrument of sight passed among three hooded keepers who hold its power in rotation. Its gaze can strip a sworn secret from any mind and, once unlocked, reveals distant places that were meant to stay hidden.

rites.name: Meralium
rites.text: Meralium is a chorus of luminous sea-singers who inhabit the drifting reef-isles of the Amontirnium deep, their harmonies bending the tides toward wreckage. Ancient navigators learned to plug their ears with resin or sing counter-chants to break the spell, and the Meralium still wait in the surf for crews who forget.

rites.name: Miresum
rites.text: Miresum is a concept of swift, wind-borne seizure found in the mythic age of Amontirnium, where thieves of breath and bread ride the storm-lanes. Its manifestations are said to strip meals and voices from the unwary, leaving only hunger in their wake.

rites.name: Cirnes
rites.text: Cirnes is a songweaver's concept in the Amontirnium cosmos, a resonance that shapes the minds of beasts and the roots of old groves. Its sustained chords can loosen the stubborn grief of the underworld's rulers for a brief hour. The power is treasured as a living bond rather than a weapon, and its echoes linger in the world long after the music fades.

rites.name: Tiarus
rites.text: Tiarus is a resonant crystalline chime of the Amontirnium, said to hum a single sustained note that makes loose mountain shale slide into terraces. Its keepers treat it as a bridge between geology and song, and it is rarely struck in full.

rites.name: Valires
rites.text: Valires is an inherited mantle of unbroken foresight, passed among blind oracles of the Amontirnium who speak only what the threads of fate already demand. Its voice is said to have warned a fallen king of his own undoing and counseled a wandering captain on the long road back to his hearth.
